mods.name: Miketavious's Auto Miner
mods.description: A client-side auto mining mod for Minecraft with durability protection and tool filtering

releases.notes:
Release v1.0.2: Minecraft 1.21.6 compatibility update

- Updated to Minecraft 1.21.6 support
- Updated all dependencies for 1.21.6 compatibility
- Improved mod compatibility by using standard Fabric keybinding APIs
- Added translation support foundation for future multi-language releases. _(If you want me to support more languages make an issue on the github repo asking what language)_

readmeSummary: Effortless mining at your fingertips! Simply look at blocks and watch them break automatically.
